scope: Fixed-law same-density AQUAL equations on exposed SPARC data. No fitted parameter, new dark halo, or microscopic derivation. Mean scores here are rounded to five decimal places; full precision and all per-row predictions are in the downloaded full artifact.
gate_meaning: Convergence alone is not accuracy certification. Require every equation's coarse/fine force change below 2 percent, screened boundary change below 0.5 percent, mass error below 0.1 percent, and solver convergence. Twenty unresolved sources are retained, not dropped to improve fit.
metric: Arithmetic mean of per-galaxy velocity RMSE in km/s
bootstrap_scope: 10000 paired galaxy-level resamples, seed 210926. Exposed-data conditional sampling variation; not full astrophysical systematics, independent confirmation or a general exclusion confidence.

source_reconstruction.meaning: Compare equations using the same reconstructed density. Changes relative to SM-1 mix source reconstruction and PDE geometry and must not all be attributed to screening.

independent_readback_audit.scope: Reconstructs all velocities, RMSEs, force gates, certified flags and score tables from saved arrays; also checks 291 CM-1 state/time points by a separate matrix exponential. Not an independent rerun of every PDE.

decision: SM-1 remains a known-framework benchmark, not a novel fundamental theory or an improved galaxy fit. Full density-based geometry does not rescue its chosen screening function under the frozen source model. Numerical failures concern these discretizations, not the whole mechanism.
